resources.string: So let\'s count what\'s left. Not years. Saturdays.
A daily reminder that you\'re alive
You\'re on bonus time. Every day is a gift with no receipt.
Put the thing that\'s eating you in here.
My boss didn\'t reply to my email…
Will this matter when the Sun becomes a red giant?
Gone. The Sun won\'t remember it either.
Okay, this one\'s real. Handle it — then let it go.
Legacy-level. Then it deserves your Saturdays, not your 3 a.m.
Bold claim. The Sun disagrees. Let it go.
Put it on the Before list
Not a bucket list. Things you\'ll regret not doing.
Call your mom. Say it out loud. Eat the ice cream.

string-array.name: questions
string-array.item: Would you still do this if you had 100 Saturdays left?
Who would you call if today were your last Saturday?
What are you putting off because you think you have time?
Whose opinion are you living for?
What would you stop doing if nobody was watching?
What did you love doing at 10 that you quit?
Is this a hell yes — or a no?

string-array.name: quotes
string-array.item: “You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think.” — Marcus Aurelius
“It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.” — Seneca
“Let us postpone nothing. Let us balance life’s books each day.” — Seneca
“Death is nothing to us.” — Epicurus
“Memento mori. Remember that you will die.” — Stoic proverb
“Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might.” — Ecclesiastes
“Dum spiro, spero. While I breathe, I hope.” — Latin proverb

string-array.name: nudges
string-array.item: We\'re all gonna die anyway. Text them first.
Worst case: you die. Which is happening regardless.
Nobody will remember this awkward moment in 100 years. Go.
The universe is 13.8 billion years old. Your embarrassment lasts 4 seconds.
You won\'t get this Saturday back. Spend it loud.
Regret weighs more than rejection.
Do it scared. Everyone else is too.
Fortune favors the mortal.
